description: This file contains the implementation of the ScriptHelper interface in Java, specifically the ScriptHelperImpl class. It provides methods for script and service execution, object creation, logging, and entity operations within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class is designed to facilitate scripting interactions with entities, services, and context management in the OFBiz platform.

classes.name: ScriptHelperImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ScriptHelper interface, providing scripting utilities such as entity retrieval, service invocation, logging, and context management within OFBiz.

methods.name: createServiceMap
methods.description: Creates a map suitable for calling a specified service, validating and preparing input parameters.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Sets error indicator and message in the context, depending on whether it is an event or service context.

methods.name: evalString
methods.description: Expands variables within the provided string using the scripting context.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Sets failure indicator and message in the context, depending on whether it is an event or service context.

methods.name: findList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entities matching specified fields.

methods.name: findOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity record, optionally with specified fields and args.

methods.name: runFindByPrimaryKey
methods.description: Executes a primary key lookup for an entity, supporting cache and field selection options.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message with script context information.

methods.name: logInfo
methods.description: Logs an informational message with script context information.

methods.name: logWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message with script context information.

methods.name: makeValue
methods.description: Creates a valid entity value object for a given entity name.

methods.name: runService
methods.description: Executes a service call with optional parameters, handling transaction and user login inclusion.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Marks the script or service execution as successful.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Marks the script or service execution as successful with a message.
